svg.title: Memory revocation: withdrawal, stale admission and physical effects
svg.desc: A schematic timeline separates detection and adjudication from authoritative withdrawal, delivery, local installation, the admission deadline and conditional recovery. Local installation blocks new affected admissions; earlier committed effects require a separate continuation and recovery contract. Positions are illustrative, not measured stopping times. Figure 3 from Governed Memory for Physical AI, by Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. Copyright © 2026 Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0. PDF vector extraction with lettering converted to paths; content unchanged.
